header.title: Glow
header.description: Neon halo that breathes behind the content. `variant` sets the look, `trigger` when it turns on and `spread` how far the light reaches. With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the halo stays still.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine props and see the generated code. `edge` only applies when `variant` is `edge`; `color` uses host palette tokens.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `halo` is a soft bloom behind the child, `outline` lights only the edge, `inner` glows from inside and `pulse` is a flash that expands, fades and repeats.

edge.title: Light from one side
edge.description: With `variant` set to `edge`, light comes from a single side. Pick it with `edge`: `top`, `right`, `bottom` (default) or `left`.

dual.title: Two colors
dual.description: `variant` set to `dual` adds a second halo with `colorAlt`, offset from the first so the colors alternate.

texts.title: Pro plan
texts.body: Unlimited deploys, custom domains and priority support.

text.title: Neon text
text.description: `variant` set to `text` draws no halo: it animates a `text-shadow` that follows the glyphs. With `asChild` it goes straight onto the heading, without a wrapping `div`.

triggers.title: Hover and click
triggers.description: With `trigger` set to `hover`, the halo lights while the pointer (or focus) is on the element. With `click`, each click turns it on or off.

spread.title: Spread
spread.description: `spread` is how far the halo extends beyond the child. A number is pixels; any CSS length (`1.5rem`) also works.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: `intensity` takes a token (`sm`, `md`, `lg`) or a number between `0` and `1`, and sets the halo's peak opacity.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: `duration` is one full breathe cycle, in milliseconds. `delay` postpones the start.

color.title: Color
color.description: `color` takes any CSS color. Prefer your app's palette tokens (`var(--gem-palette-*)`) so the halo follows the theme.

asChild.title: asChild
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the effect is applied to the child without a wrapping `div`. Here, on a gem-system `Button`.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the breathe cycle on the current frame. `isDisabled` hides the halo and keeps the child interactive.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onGlow` fires when the halo turns on and `outGlow` when it turns off, with the cause in `event.reason`. The halo doesn't block interaction: the inner button still gets clicks.

texts.title: Concert tickets
texts.body: Hover the card and watch the log.

styled.title: Sunset
styled.body: Gradient halo, defined in your own class.

header.title: Glow API
header.description: Reference for `Glow` props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for each variant and trigger.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/glow` with its `glow.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> except color, and passes them to the root div (or the child, with asChild). onClick, onPointerEnter and onPointerLeave run before the effect's own logic.

items.hidden: The halo layer has aria-hidden and pointer-events: none: it's decorative and doesn't block the child.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the animation stops and the halo stays still (a static text-shadow for text).
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) forces the animation. Use it only when motion is essential.
items.focus: With trigger="hover", the halo also lights on keyboard focus (:focus-visible on the root or inside), so it shows while tabbing. A mouse click that focuses a button doesn't keep it on. onGlow only fires for the pointer.
items.click: With trigger="click", the toggle listens to click on the root. If the child is a button (as in the asChild example), Enter and Space work too.
items.touch: Touch screens have no hover: prefer always or click.
items.meaning: The halo is decoration: don't use it as the only state cue (selected, error). Pair it with text or an ARIA attribute.

items.trigger: Active trigger. Hides the halo until hover/focus or click.
items.inactive: Added with `isActive={false}` or `isDisabled`; hides the halo.
items.disabled: Added with `isDisabled`. Removes the pointer cursor.
items.layer: Absolute layer behind the child that holds the halos.
items.halo: Main halo. `outline` and `inner` use `box-shadow` instead of blur.
items.surface: Wraps the child, above the layer. Carries the `text-shadow` for `text`.

items.colorAlt: Second halo color for `dual`. Set by `colorAlt`; default `var(--gem-palette-secondary-400)`.
items.delay: Delay before starting. Set by `delay`; default `0ms`.
items.intensity: Halo peak opacity. Set by `intensity`; default `var(--gemfx-intensity-md)`.
items.blur: Halo blur. No prop: change it from CSS; default `1.35rem`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables Glow reads as defaults.

items.palette: Default `color` and `colorAlt`, with a neon fallback when gem-system isn't loaded.

content.title: Content
content.description: What lights up and where the effect mounts.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Halo shape, color, reach and intensity.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When the halo turns on and how it pauses or turns off.

items.children: Content that sits in front of the halo.
items.asChild: Applies the effect to the single child, without a wrapping `div`. Works with every variant, `text` included. With a void element (`img`, `input`) it falls back to the `div`, since the halo layer can't mount inside it.
items.edge: Side that emits light when `variant` is `edge`.
items.color: Halo color. Prefer host tokens (`var(--gem-palette-primary-400)`). An empty string uses the default.
items.spread: How far the halo extends beyond the child. A number is pixels; a string is used as is.
items.intensity: Halo strength: token or number between `0` and `1`.
items.duration: One full breathe cycle. Negative values become `0`.
items.trigger: `always` stays on, `hover` while the pointer or focus is on it, `click` toggles on each click.
items.isActive: Shows the halo. `false` hides it and `outGlow` gets `inactive`.
items.isPaused: Freezes the animation on the current frame.
items.isDisabled: Hides the halo; the child stays interactive. `outGlow` gets `disabled`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only when motion is essential.
items.onGlow: Fires when the halo turns on: on mount with `always`, on pointer enter with `hover` or when toggled on with `click`.
items.outGlow: Fires when the halo turns off: on pointer leave, when toggled off with `click`, when disabled or on unmount.
items.style: Root inline styles. Merged with the `--gemfx-glow-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
